text:
Aisha (Marketing): Heads-up — target announce for Redwood Optimize v1.2 is next Wed 10:00 AM PT. Need eng sign-off on changelog + docs links by EOD Friday.
Tom (Eng): Copy. Can you confirm canary window and acceptable rollback time?
Aisha (Marketing): Ideally a 30m canary earlier that morning (08:30–09:00 PT). Rollback plan should be <15m.
Priya (Product): Webinar ask: can we aim for Wed 12:00 PM PT for a short 30m demo + AMA? Marketing needs the landing page and speaker list by Monday.
Ben (Docs): I can have the docs pages up; will need final changelog and code samples by Thursday morning. Draft permalink: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/optimize-v1-2 (will publish when final).
Tom (Eng): On changelog — pushing a small formatting request: include migration note about batching config and quantization presets. Also we need benchmark phrasing agreed w/ ML.
Priya (Product): Benchmarks: we can state median token latency improvements and cost per token delta. No comparative claims vs specific vendors without legal. Suggest: "~2x throughput on seq=512 workloads vs baseline config."
Aisha (Marketing): Good — please give exact numbers or ranges. Marketing narrative: launch post will highlight throughput gains, 20% estimated cost savings for chat workloads, and a short customer quote (TBD).
Marina (Sales Ops): Routing note — please tag announce traffic so inbound leads can be auto-triaged. Proposed route config snippet for the ops team:
```
source: announce.opt_v1.2
route: sales/inbound?priority=announce&region=NA
notify: sales-ops+announce
```
Marina (Sales Ops): Sales want a lead-handback template: timestamp, scoring, trial-credit code field.
Tom (Eng): Canary window looks fine. We'll spin canary on dedicated-1 at 08:30 PT. Deploy plan: canary (30m) -> gradual 10% steps over 2h -> full. Rollback command: `./deploy rollback --release optimize-v1.2 --target dedicated-1`.
DeployBot: Canary started on dedicated-1 for release optimize-v1.2 — monitoring hooks active. :satellite:
Ben (Docs): Draft changelog block (put in CHANGELOG.md section):
```
## Optimize v1.2 (2026-04-01)
- Improved continuous batching throughput (seq=512): +95% median throughput
- New quantization presets for T4 and A10x: reduces token cost by ~20% in typical chat workloads
- Migration: update `batch.max_tokens` to new default `2048` for better headroom
```
Ben (Docs): I'll drop that into the docs page; please annotate any wording edits.
Priya (Product): Can marketing and docs avoid concrete competitor names in the launch post. Use "comparable open models" if needed. Legal already flagged direct naming.
Aisha (Marketing): Noted. Also draft webinar CTAs: sign-up link, demo script, and 3 slides on benchmarks. I'll circulate slide deck template by EOD Monday.
Marina (Sales Ops): Do we have a promo code for webinar signups tied to SDR routing? If yes, share by Tuesday.
Tom (Eng): One more ask: if we show benchmark graphs, include raw test config (seq/bs/model/quant) in appendix. Ben can attach that to docs.
Ben (Docs): Yep, will add an appendix with the benchmark run command and seed values. Example: `./bench --model redwood-optimize --seq 512 --batch 8 --runs 100`.
Aisha (Marketing): Checklist for sign-off (please reply thumbs-up when done):
- [ ] Final changelog copy (eng)
- [ ] Docs permalink live (docs)
- [ ] Canary window scheduled (eng/deploy)
- [ ] Webinar landing page + speaker list (marketing/product)
- [ ] Lead routing config + promo code (sales ops)
- [ ] Benchmark appendix added (docs/ml)
Tom (Eng): 👍 will take lead on changelog and canary scheduling.
Ben (Docs): 👍 will publish docs permalink when final text arrives.
Priya (Product): 👍 I'll confirm webinar speakers and final slide bullets Monday.
Marina (Sales Ops): 👍 will prepare routing rules and draft template for SDRs.
Aisha (Marketing): Great — goal: all green by Friday EOD for announce on Wed. Ping me if anyone is blocked. :eyes:
